almas-folklore.notes: Stooped reddish-brown humanoid ape, long arms and two feet in rocky mountain terrain; no extra hybrid features.

amaru-mythology.notes: One continuous serpent with bird head and puma head at opposite ends beside Andean lake.

ammit.notes: One crocodile head, lion forelegs and shoulders, hippo hindquarters on one four-legged body.

amphiptere.notes: One snake head and continuous legless serpent body with two feathered wings.

amarum.notes: One large continuous boa body and boa head beside rainy Amazon river, no appendages.

anansi.notes: Compact spider with eight legs and one human face, no human torso or arms.

anggitay.notes: Clothed female torso joins horse body with equine legs and one tail, no horn or wings.

anzu.notes: Single lion head and mane on feathered bird body with two taloned feet and two wings.

aoandon.notes: Blue-skinned woman with two horns, pointed teeth, Japanese robe and blue lantern.

aosaginohi.notes: Heron beak, neck and two slender legs; eyes and feathered wings glow without fire.

apophis.notes: Single giant limbless serpent in Egyptian river landscape, no crown or wings.

asena.notes: Natural grey wolf with four legs and bushy tail at mountain cave, no hybrid anatomy.

ayakashi-yokai.notes: One very long sea snake with continuous serpentine body and small empty boat for scale.

azhdaha.notes: Thick giant serpent with bright eyes and broad tooth-filled reptilian mouth; no limbs or wings.

baca-mythological-creature.notes: Entirely black dog familiar, natural canine head, four legs and one tail.

abada-unicorn.notes: Final edited image: two crooked horns, four solid single-piece equine hooves, short boar-like tufted tail and donkey-sized body.

previous_attempts.notes: Second attempt still has split cloven hooves; requires solid single-piece equine hooves.

anhanga.notes: Natural white deer with four slender legs and glowing fiery eyes; body is not burning.

badalisc.notes: Oversized shaggy head, two small horns, glowing eyes and large open mouth on a low beast body.

bake-danuki.notes: Single iron kettle with four furry tanuki legs and bushy tail on tatami floor.

bake-kujira.notes: Complete whale skeleton with long skull, ribcage, spine, bony flippers and vertebral tail at sea surface.

bakeneko.notes: Natural cat upright on hind paws, gesturing forepaws and one unsplit tail.

griffin.notes: Eagle head, hooked beak, pointed ears, feathered wings and lion body; taloned forefeet and lion hindfeet.

baku-mythology.notes: Elephant trunk and two tusks, small rounded ears, stocky furry body, clawed paws and bovine tail.

bakunawa.notes: Single curved serpentine dragon with one nasal horn, mouth facing the moon and recurved tail, no wings.

basan-legendary-bird.notes: Rooster head with comb and wattles, two bird legs and feathered wings; flame breath only.

bashe.notes: Giant continuous thick python body with broad natural snake head, no limbs or hybrids.

basilisco-chilote.notes: Continuous legless snake body with one reptilian head and clearly visible red rooster comb.

beast-of-bray-road.notes: Wolf head and orange glowing eyes on fur-covered upright humanoid with two arms and legs.

beast-of-busco.notes: Huge snapping turtle with ridged shell, beaked head, four stout legs and long reptile tail.

bessie-lake-monster.notes: One grey continuous serpent surfaced in misty lake, no plesiosaur flippers or hybrid features.

bifang.notes: Crane-like bird with exactly one visible leg, green plumage, red markings and white beak.

bigfoot.notes: Tall broad dark-brown ape-like biped, two long arms and two feet in conifer woods.

bixi.notes: Dragon head on four-legged turtle body carrying one upright stone stele on its shell.

boiuna.notes: Glossy black giant continuous snake with one head surfacing in dark Amazon river.

bozalosc.notes: White-dressed female spirit with long unkempt hair and red eyes near elder bush.

buggane.notes: Huge coarse black-haired beast with mane, torch-bright eyes and two projecting tusks at ruined church.

bungisngis.notes: Single central eye, two long tusks, large teeth and thick upper lip on clothed humanoid giant.

bunzi.notes: One continuous limbless snake with natural head and multicolored iridescent rainbow scales.

caballo-marino-chilote.notes: Long equine snout, golden mane, four fin-like paws and long fish tail in underwater setting.

caballucos-del-diablu.notes: Revised red Percheron with black mane and exactly two narrow transparent insect wings, one per side; four equine legs.

previous_attempts.notes: Horse has four transparent insect wings instead of the required exactly two damselfly wings.

catoblepas.notes: Stocky dark buffalo form with horns and very heavy head hanging near ground.

centaur.notes: Male human torso and arms join complete four-legged horse body with one tail, modest waist cloth.

cha-kla.notes: Black feline creature with red eyes and coarse fur visibly swept forward and upward.

cheval-gauvin.notes: Natural four-legged horse with mane and tail by dark forest stream, no rider or hybrid features.

cheval-mallet.notes: White horse with visible saddle and bridle, alone on night rural path.

chi-mythology.notes: Hornless scaled Chinese dragon with four clawed legs, smooth head without antlers, no wings.

chickcharney.notes: Revised red-eyed feathered bird with exactly three toes on each foot, two forward and one rear; long prehensile tail wraps branch.

previous_attempts.notes: Bird feet include a rear toe in addition to three forward toes, making four rather than the required three toes per foot.

chimera-mythology.notes: One lion body and four lion legs, lion front head, goat head on back and snake head at tail end.

cabra-cabriola.notes: Revised four-legged goat beast with exactly two curved horns, sharp teeth and flame breath, no extra horn pair.

previous_attempts.notes: Goat-like beast has four horns including an extra smaller pair; replace with clear two-horn goat anatomy.

cadejo.notes: Large calm dark dog with luminous blue eyes, four canine legs and no horns.

capelobo.notes: Stocky tapir-like quadruped covered in long black hair with doglike snout and four sturdy legs.

cerberus.notes: One dog body with four legs, exactly three dog heads and one snake-headed tail.

chonchon.notes: Detached feathered human head with two huge ear-shaped wings and two small talons underneath.

chupacabra.notes: Hairless grey wrinkled canine quadruped, narrow snout and pointed ears; Southwestern US variant.

cockatrice.notes: Rooster head with comb and wattles, reptilian body, exactly two legs and two bat wings, one serpent tail.

colo-colo-mythology.notes: Rat head and four rat feet, long rat tail; body clearly covered with layered feathers.

cressie.notes: One dark-brown eel with low continuous dorsal fin and natural eel head underwater, no horns or limbs.

cuelebre.notes: One coiled continuous legless serpent with two bat wings beside cave treasure.

curupira.notes: Final rear three-quarter view: back, hips and knees face into forest away from viewer; both reversed feet have all toes facing viewer, opposite body direction. Flame-red hair, two arms and legs, modest woven wrap.

previous_attempts.notes: Only one foot clearly points backwards while the other points forward; both feet must point backwards relative to face and knees.

dahu.notes: Revised frontal three-quarter view: animal left legs on image-right uphill are conspicuously shorter; right-side downhill legs longer, four hooves on slope.

previous_attempts.notes: Near-side left legs appear longer rather than shorter, and required left/right asymmetry is not unambiguous.

dawon.notes: Natural lion with full mane, four lion legs and tufted tail, alone in Indian forest.

delphyne.notes: Single natural giant snake head and continuous thick body among Greek limestone, no human hybrid.

demon-cat.notes: Giant black natural cat with two ears, four legs and one tail in historic stone corridor.

dewey-lake-monster.notes: Massive hair-covered humanoid ape biped with two arms, two legs and distinctly glowing eyes.

dip-catalan-myth.notes: Shaggy black dog with one foreleg visibly held off ground, natural canine anatomy.

diting.notes: Single tiger head, doglike ears and one horn, scaled dragon body, four hooves and tufted lion tail.

dodomeki.notes: Adult Japanese woman with many small eyes on both exposed forearms, normal two-eyed face and clothed torso.

european-dragon.notes: Horned scaled lizard dragon with four clawed legs, two leathery wings, one tail and short flame breath.

fish-man.notes: Pale red-haired human man with neck gill marks and vertical scale strip down chest, trousers and human limbs.

flaming-teeth.notes: Clothed humanoid giant with oversized glowing burning-log teeth; body and face not burning.

flatwoods-monster.notes: Round red face surrounded by pointed ace-of-spades hood, small claw hands and folded garment body.

flying-head.notes: One huge detached human head with long dark hair, large fanged mouth and intense eyes, no torso or ear wings.

forest-bull.notes: Tawny bovine quadruped with wide earward-gaping mouth and two horns pointing in different directions.

fouke-monster.notes: Large biped with long dark hair, humanoid ape face, two arms and two feet in swamp woods.

furaribi.notes: Doglike face on feathered bird body with two legs and two wings, surrounding flame aura.

futakuchi-onna.notes: One normal female face and exactly one additional mouth visible on back of head through parted black hair.

fuzhu-mythical-beast.notes: Revised deerlike quadruped has exactly four separate unbranched horns with four clear roots, short front pair and tall rear pair.

previous_attempts.notes: Only three distinct horns are present; required four independently visible horns.

gaasyendietha.notes: Single continuous legless scaled serpent over lake with meteoric glowing outline, no wings.

gloucester-sea-serpent.notes: Massive continuous serpent showing repeated clear humps at sea surface, one head and small boat for scale.

goatman-urban-legend.notes: Goat head with beard and two horns joins humanlike torso, two arms and upright goat legs, modest waist wrap.

gaueko.notes: Large natural black wolf with four legs and bushy tail, no glowing red eyes or hybrid features.

akugyo.notes: Giant fish with shining scales, natural fish head, fins and caudal fin underwater.

alara-fairy.notes: Revised clothed girl-like fairy has exactly two single undivided butterfly-pattern wings, one per side, no extra lower lobes.

previous_attempts.notes: Four separate butterfly wing lobes instead of required exactly two individual wings.

anqa.notes: Human female face on long golden bird neck, avian body and feet, eight feathered wings in four separate pairs.

ahriman.notes: Single natural dark snake manifestation with continuous scaled body, no humanoid demon anatomy.

akuma-folklore.notes: Clothed humanoid spirit with fiery head and eyes, one sword and normal two arms and legs.

almaz-mythical-beast.notes: Adult female forest being with exceptionally long golden hair and modest draped clothing, no hybrid features.

aloja-mythology.notes: Golden-haired emerald-eyed clothed woman looks into lake reflection under full moon, no wings or fish tail.

ama-no-fuchigoma.notes: Natural four-legged horse with mane and tail on misty Japanese path, no rider or invented hybrid anatomy.

akerbeltz.notes: Black male goat, beard, two backward-curved horns, four cloven hooves and short tail beside cave.

ahuizotl-mythology.notes: Small wet-furred canine quadruped with prehensile tail terminating in a visible five-digit humanlike hand.

akashita.notes: Shaggy beast head and claws emerge from black cloud with large red tongue above wooden floodgate.

busaw.notes: Clothed humanlike nocturnal spirit beneath tree with pointed teeth, long tongue and clearly hooked fingernails.

aatxe.notes: Young red natural bull with two short horns, four bovine legs and normal tail at cave mouth.

abaia.notes: Giant freshwater eel with natural head and low dorsal fin, resting underwater with small fish for scale.

ahkiyyini.notes: Human skeleton dances on shore holding long arm bone drumstick and scapula drum, no flesh.

aisha-qandicha.notes: Moroccan woman with modest robe and two goatlike lower legs ending in clearly visible cloven hooves.

akhekh.notes: Crocodile-like snout on elongated scaled body with four reptile legs and two feathered bird wings.

akurra.notes: Giant continuous water snake with fangs and conspicuous beardlike head and neck mane, no limbs.

alicanto.notes: Running grounded two-legged bird with two metallic golden feathered wings outspread, no flames.
